featured_reviews.name: Sameera Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the overall experience at Cult Fit, especially with regard to trainer management, customer communication, and grievance handling.

I had enrolled in a personal training package after investing a significant amount of money, with the expectation of receiving consistent and personalized guidance. However, my assigned trainer was removed without any prior intimation to me. There was no communication, no transition plan, and not even a basic courtesy message informing me that the trainer would no longer be available.

I only discovered something was wrong when I was unable to book my training session through the app. I then had to make several calls and follow up with multiple people just to understand what the issue was. To my surprise, I was informed that the trainer had been removed. This is not how paying clients should be treated.

What is even more disappointing is that despite several follow-ups, I have not been provided with any clear resolution. The lack of communication, accountability, and customer support has been extremely frustrating and unprofessional.

A substantial amount of my money is now stuck in an unused personal training package. I paid for personal training sessions in good faith, yet after the trainer was removed, no satisfactory alternative or resolution has been offered. To make matters worse, there has been no willingness to refund the amount corresponding to the unused sessions. As a customer, I should not have to bear the financial loss arising from internal staffing decisions made by the company.

This seems to reflect a larger issue with trainer retention. Even in group classes, trainers keep changing very frequently, forcing members to repeatedly adjust to different trainers. Consistency is an important part of any fitness journey, and frequent trainer changes significantly affect the overall experience. Personal trainers, too, do not seem to stay for long, which defeats the purpose of building continuity, trust, and personalized guidance.

For a brand that positions itself as a premium fitness provider, this level of service is highly disappointing. Members invest not only money but also time, trust, and commitment. The least that can be expected is proper communication, transparency, and a well-planned transition whenever changes directly impact clients.

I sincerely hope Cult Fit reviews its trainer retention policies, improves its communication with members, and handles customer grievances more responsibly. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend their services.
